HUONG DAN TAI LEN CLOUDFLARE PAGES

1. Dang nhap Cloudflare Dashboard.
2. Mo Workers & Pages.
3. Chon Create application > Get started > Drag and drop your files.
4. Dat ten du an, vi du: so-tay-dien-thoai.
5. Keo file so-tay-dien-thoai-cloudflare.zip vao khu vuc tai len.
6. Chon Deploy site.

BAO MAT QUAN TRONG

Danh ba nay la tai lieu luu hanh noi bo. Sau khi trien khai, URL pages.dev co the
duoc truy cap cong khai neu khong co lop bao ve. Hay bat Cloudflare Zero Trust
Access cho ten mien cua ung dung va chi cho phep tai khoan/co quan duoc uy quyen.

File _headers da duoc them de chan lap trang, han che quyen trinh duyet, ngan cong
cu tim kiem lap chi muc va khong cache tep du lieu danh ba. Cac header nay khong
thay the cho dang nhap Cloudflare Access.
